description: Golden tutoring cases for Bloom progression, teaching quality, and misconception handling.

cases.prompt: I sort of get what vector embeddings are, but I can't explain why they help retrieval. Teach me without just dumping the answer.
expected_behaviors: Start by probing the learner's current model.
Use questions or scaffolding instead of immediately giving a full explanation.
Move the learner toward deeper understanding at an appropriate level.
disallowed_behaviors: Dump a lecture without checking understanding.
Jump to advanced theory before grounding basics.
